claim: We have achieved carbon neutrality across all our operations.
evidence: Our Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions increased by 3% year-over-year, totaling 45 million tonnes of CO2 equivalent in 2023.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: Direct contradiction between neutrality claim and rising emissions data.

claim: Our renewable energy portfolio now powers 100% of our data centers.
evidence: We have signed Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) for renewable energy equivalent to 100% of our global data center electricity consumption.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: PPA coverage matches the claim; methodologically sound.

claim: We are committed to achieving net zero emissions by 2050.
evidence: The company has announced a long-term ambition to reach net zero greenhouse gas emissions across all operations by 2050, subject to supportive government policy.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: Claim matches announcement, but conditioned on policy—subtle risk.

claim: We reduced our carbon footprint by 50% over the last decade.
evidence: Absolute Scope 1 emissions have decreased by 12% since 2013, while production volumes have grown by 35%.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: 12% vs claimed 50%; production growth makes intensity reduction misleading.

claim: Our supply chain is 100% deforestation-free.
evidence: We are working with suppliers to implement zero-deforestation commitments and have made progress in key commodity supply chains.
label: NEUTRAL
annotator_notes: Evidence shows progress/commitment, not verified achievement.

claim: We invest more in clean energy than any other oil company.
evidence: Capital expenditure on low-carbon energy solutions represents 15% of total investment, with $4.5 billion allocated in 2023.
label: NEUTRAL
annotator_notes: Evidence doesn't confirm comparative claim vs peers.

claim: All our plastic packaging is recyclable or reusable.
evidence: We have committed to making 100% of our plastic packaging recyclable, reusable, or compostable by 2025; currently at 78% as of 2023.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: Current state (78%) contradicts the absolute claim.

claim: We have eliminated all single-use plastics from our offices.
evidence: Single-use plastics have been phased out from all corporate headquarters and major office locations globally as of Q2 2023.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: Evidence directly supports the specific claim about offices.

claim: Our new electric vehicle lineup will eliminate tailpipe emissions.
evidence: The ID. series electric vehicles produce zero direct tailpipe CO2 emissions during operation, though lifecycle emissions depend on electricity grid mix.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: Tailpipe claim is technically accurate; lifecycle caveat noted in evidence.

claim: We are carbon negative and remove more CO2 than we emit.
evidence: Total Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions were 55.8 million tonnes CO2e in 2023; carbon removal projects offset 1.2 million tonnes.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: Offsets (1.2Mt) are a fraction of total emissions (55.8Mt); claim is false.

claim: Our operations run entirely on renewable energy.
evidence: Renewable energy accounts for approximately 45% of our total energy consumption across global operations.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: 45% ≠ entirely; clear quantitative contradiction.

claim: We have planted one million trees to offset our emissions.
evidence: As part of our reforestation initiative, we have planted over 1.2 million trees across 15 countries since 2020.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: Number exceeds claim; credible with specifics.

claim: We are reducing emissions faster than any competitor in our sector.
evidence: Year-over-year Scope 1 emissions declined by 8%, compared to an industry average decline of 3.2% reported by the IEA.
label: NEUTRAL
annotator_notes: Evidence shows above-average performance but doesn't confirm 'any competitor'.

claim: Our products are designed with a zero-waste philosophy.
evidence: We have adopted circular design principles, with 83% of our product materials being recyclable at end of life.
label: NEUTRAL
annotator_notes: 83% recyclable is not zero-waste; partial support.

claim: We have achieved a 30% reduction in water usage.
evidence: Water withdrawal intensity (per unit production) decreased by 29.7% compared to our 2018 baseline.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: Rounds to 30%; intensity-based metric matches claim.

claim: All electricity used in our manufacturing is from solar power.
evidence: We source renewable electricity for manufacturing through a combination of on-site solar (32%), wind PPAs (41%), and hydro certificates (27%).
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: Only 32% is solar; the rest is other renewables—claim is inaccurate.

claim: We will be fully electric by 2030.
evidence: We are targeting 50% of global sales to be fully electric vehicles by 2030, with full electrification of new models by 2035.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: 50% sales target vs claim of 'fully electric'; also date mismatch (2035 for full).

claim: Our packaging uses 100% recycled materials.
evidence: Recycled content in our product packaging reached 92% in 2023, up from 78% in 2021.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: 92% ≠ 100%; ongoing progress but claim is inaccurate.

claim: We offset all business travel emissions through carbon credits.
evidence: We purchase verified carbon offsets corresponding to 100% of employee air travel and rental car emissions annually.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: Direct match; offset program specifically covers business travel.

claim: Our new refinery is the most energy-efficient in the world.
evidence: The Rotterdam refinery achieved an energy intensity index (EII) of 87.3, ranking in the top quartile of global refinery performance benchmarks.
label: NEUTRAL
annotator_notes: Top quartile ≠ most efficient; superlative claim not supported.

claim: We have zero methane emissions from our operations.
evidence: Methane intensity (methane emissions per unit of natural gas produced) was 0.04%, down from 0.06% in 2020.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: 0.04% intensity is not zero; small but nonzero emissions confirmed.

claim: We are committed to transparent emissions reporting aligned with TCFD.
evidence: Our climate disclosures follow the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) framework, with independent third-party verification of Scope 1 and 2 data.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: TCFD alignment and third-party verification directly support transparency claim.

claim: Our cloud infrastructure is powered by renewable energy.
evidence: Amazon Web Services matched 100% of electricity consumption with renewable energy in 2023, making it the world's largest corporate buyer of renewable energy.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: 100% renewable energy matching for AWS confirmed with superlative detail.

claim: We have eliminated all fossil fuels from our energy mix.
evidence: Natural gas continues to supply approximately 18% of our global energy needs, with coal fully phased out by end of 2022.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: Natural gas (fossil fuel) still at 18%; coal phased out but not all fossil fuels.

claim: We are investing $10 billion in green hydrogen by 2030.
evidence: Shell has committed to investing up to $10 billion in green hydrogen production and infrastructure between 2023 and 2030.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: Specific investment figure and timeline match exactly.

claim: Our biodiversity programs protect endangered species globally.
evidence: We support biodiversity conservation projects in 12 countries, with a focus on habitat restoration in operational areas.
label: NEUTRAL
annotator_notes: Habitat restoration doesn't specifically confirm endangered species protection.

claim: We have cut Scope 3 emissions by 40% since 2015.
evidence: Scope 3 emissions reporting was initiated in 2020; baseline data prior to 2020 is not available for comparison.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: No 2015 baseline exists; claim of 40% reduction is unverifiable and likely fabricated.

claim: All our tier-1 suppliers meet our environmental standards.
evidence: 87% of tier-1 suppliers completed our environmental self-assessment questionnaire in 2023; 63% met our minimum standards threshold.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: Only 63% meet standards; 'all' is clearly inaccurate.

claim: Our operations are fully aligned with the Paris Agreement.
evidence: We have set science-based targets approved by the SBTi, with a 1.5°C pathway for Scope 1 and 2, and a well-below-2°C pathway for Scope 3.
label: NEUTRAL
annotator_notes: SBTi targets support alignment claim but Scope 3 at 2°C (not 1.5°C) weakens it.

claim: We recycle 95% of our operational waste.
evidence: In 2023, 94.8% of waste generated across our manufacturing and logistics operations was diverted from landfill through recycling and energy recovery.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: 94.8% rounds to 95%; 'diversion' includes energy recovery which covers recycling.

claim: We have achieved ISO 14001 certification across all facilities.
evidence: ISO 14001 environmental management certification has been obtained for 89% of our global manufacturing facilities as of December 2023.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: 89% ≠ all; non-trivial gap.

claim: Our electric vehicles save customers money on fuel.
evidence: Total cost of ownership analysis shows EV drivers save an average of $1,200 annually on fuel and maintenance compared to equivalent ICE vehicles.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: TCO data directly confirms financial savings claim.

claim: We have not increased production of fossil fuels since 2020.
evidence: Hydrocarbon production increased from 3.7 million barrels of oil equivalent per day in 2020 to 3.9 million boe/d in 2023.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: Production clearly increased; claim is factually false.

claim: We are the greenest company in the technology sector.
evidence: Apple achieved carbon neutrality for corporate operations in 2020 and is on track for full carbon neutrality across its value chain by 2030.
label: NEUTRAL
annotator_notes: Strong performance but superlative 'greenest' not supported by comparative data.

claim: We use only sustainably sourced materials in our products.
evidence: Sustainably certified materials account for 71% of our total material procurement by volume, with a target of 100% by 2025.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: 71% vs 'only' sustainable materials; significant portion still not certified.

claim: We have a net positive impact on biodiversity.
evidence: Our biodiversity net gain assessments are in progress for 40% of operational sites; full assessment completion expected by 2025.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: Assessments incomplete; cannot claim net positive without data.

claim: Our carbon offset projects are independently verified.
evidence: All carbon offset purchases are sourced from projects verified under the Verified Carbon Standard (VCS) or Gold Standard certification schemes.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: VCS and Gold Standard are recognized independent verification schemes.

claim: We will stop all oil exploration by 2025.
evidence: New oil and gas exploration licenses were awarded to the company in 2023, including deepwater blocks in the Gulf of Mexico and West Africa.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: New exploration licenses directly contradict the stop-exploration claim.

claim: Our annual sustainability report is audited by a third party.
evidence: Deloitte has provided limited assurance on selected environmental and social metrics as disclosed in our 2023 Sustainability Report.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: 'Limited assurance' is a form of third-party audit; claim holds with appropriate caveat.

claim: We have transitioned all employee commutes to zero-emission vehicles.
evidence: We offer EV charging at 45% of our corporate campuses and provide subsidies for employees purchasing electric vehicles.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: Subsidies/charging ≠ full transition; most employees still use personal non-EV transport.

claim: We are reducing plastic use across our entire value chain.
evidence: Total plastic use across our upstream and downstream operations increased by 4% in 2023 due to expanded packaging requirements.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: Plastic use increased; claim of reduction is factually contradicted.

claim: We support community renewable energy projects worldwide.
evidence: We have funded 23 community solar and wind projects in 8 countries, providing clean energy access to over 50,000 households.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: Specific, verifiable data strongly supports the claim.

claim: Our emissions reduction targets are science-based.
evidence: Our greenhouse gas reduction targets have been validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) as consistent with a 1.5°C warming scenario.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: SBTi validation is the standard definition of science-based targets.

claim: We have eliminated all coal from our energy supply.
evidence: Coal was fully phased out from our energy mix in 2021, replaced by natural gas and renewables across all major facilities.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: Full coal phase-out confirmed with year and replacement details.

claim: Our green bonds fund only renewable energy projects.
evidence: Proceeds from our $3 billion green bond issuance in 2022 were allocated to renewable energy (68%), energy efficiency (22%), and green buildings (10%).
label: NEUTRAL
annotator_notes: 68% to renewables, but 'only' is inaccurate—other green categories also funded.

claim: We have zero waste-to-landfill across all manufacturing sites.
evidence: 12 of our 47 manufacturing facilities have achieved zero-waste-to-landfill status; the remainder are progressing toward this goal.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: Only 12/47 sites achieve this; 'all' manufacturing sites is false.

claim: Our reforestation program has restored 500,000 hectares of forest.
evidence: Since 2019, our reforestation and afforestation programs have restored or protected 480,000 hectares of forest globally.
label: NEUTRAL
annotator_notes: 480,000 is close to but not 500,000; minor discrepancy, and 'protected' ≠ 'restored'.

claim: All our logistics partners meet our environmental certification requirements.
evidence: We require logistics partners to hold ISO 14001 or equivalent certification; 74% of partners are currently certified.
label: REFUTE
annotator_notes: Requirement exists but only 74% comply; 'all' is demonstrably false.

claim: We are committed to protecting ocean health through pollution reduction.
evidence: We have implemented zero-discharge policies for all offshore platforms and participate in the Global Plastic Action Partnership.
label: SUPPORT
annotator_notes: Zero-discharge policy and GPAP participation support the ocean protection commitment.

claim: Our net zero strategy covers all three emission scopes.
evidence: Our net zero pathway includes Scope 1 and Scope 2 targets with verified plans; Scope 3 targets are under development pending improved measurement methodology.
label: NEUTRAL
annotator_notes: Scope 3 targets still in development; strategy does not yet fully cover all three scopes.
